releaseNotes: Fixes the update loop on the office PC. Recovery Hub reported a hardcoded 4.8.2 however many times you installed a newer build, so the updater kept offering the same version for ever; the version the app reports is now generated from the installer version and the two cannot drift apart again. First-run setup no longer demands an Excel billing workbook before it will start - the office keeps its books in Recovery Hub's own database and a spreadsheet is only ever imported or exported.
